name: New Vintage
description: Everything your AI needs to work  with your winery's data. Explore Commerce7, RedChirp, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, and more. Use for reporting, segmentation, and to identify revenue opportunities.

_published_faq.name: How do I add New Vintage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add New Vintage to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.newvintage.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the New Vintage MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Vintage provides these MCP tools: describe_tenant_sql_sources, discover_tenant_data_sources, get_more_tools, list_tenant_sql_sources, and safe_tenant_sql.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to New Vintage?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to New Vintage in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does New Vintage MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: New Vintage requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
New Vintage is developed by New Vintage Labs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
